svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Fig. R2 — The field in the ring's mid-plane (top view)
by symmetry B lies in the mid-plane, so these lines are exact; lines from the outer N faces, arrows N → S; arrows in the sections are M
Along the ring, alternating: 12 poles at the joints
Control, all outward: no poles round the side
Outside lines leave the plane only in the control, where the flux of the all-N outer face returns over the top and bottom into the all-S bore.
